format_comparison_contract: Performance and quality within a format load the same checkpoint and identical quantization mode; no extra norm rescaling is introduced. Actual installed tensor sizes, routing normalization and backend are recorded per run.

memory_planning_contract.status: planned_unprofiled; recommendations are metadata, not runner defaults or a launch instruction
memory_planning_contract.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition, nominal 96 GB
memory_planning_contract.planning_total_memory_source: runs/graph_resume_r05/stdout.log: vLLM reports 94.97 GiB total and 33.24 GiB requested at utilization 0.35; rounded runtime denominator is used instead of equating nominal 96 GB with 96 GiB.
memory_planning_contract.format_budget_policy: For each model, BF16 and FP8 use the same total gpu_memory_utilization budget; this does not force identical KV capacity. If profiling requires a budget change, apply it to both formats and every compared policy.
memory_planning_contract.kv_dtype_policy: With dtype=bfloat16 and kv_cache_dtype=auto, vLLM resolves the cache to bfloat16 even when weights use online FP8; no KV compression is assumed from weight quantization.
estimate_boundaries: KV counts include every attention layer, including DeepSeek layer0 whose MLP is dense; DeepSeek uses the compressed MLA cache, not expanded per-head K/V.
Estimates exclude runtime weight-layout changes, graph pools, activations/logits, MLA prefill expansion, backend workspaces, allocator fragmentation, page tables, and spare KV blocks.
KV payload is before block rounding and backend padding. 2176 tokens is divisible by block sizes 16/32/64/128; other cache block sizes require per-request rounding.
Checkpoint payload plus KV is an accounting estimate, not a proven fit. Online-FP8 load/conversion peaks and actual usable memory remain unprofiled.

Verify loaded model, KV blocks, peak memory, free device memory and graph capture under the exact launch arguments. vLLM startup profiling determines whether all 64 target contexts fit without preemption.
Existing runner memory and max_model_len defaults are unchanged; these recommendations require explicit launch arguments.
Longer outputs require recalculating 64 * (prefix_tokens + output_tokens) and per-request page rounding. In particular, OLMoE 0.35 is provisional for this scenario, not a final memory constraint.
memory_planning_contract.target_scope: This static scenario covers only B=64 with prefix128 + output2048. It does not freeze output length or final memory fractions. The graph pilot will set a common energy-measurement length targeting at least 3 seconds; if output exceeds 2048, recompute KV and profile again before fixing budgets.
